blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — JP Bugaoan erupted for 19 points to power Savouge past sister team ClearSkiiin, 23-25, 25-16, 25-20, 25-17, in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Saturday at the Philsports Arena. Bugaoan led the Spin Doctors’ charge as they recovered from a first-set loss to claim the four-set victory, finishing with 10 kills, six blocks, and three aces. “I told the team, no mercy, because it was our last game in the elimination round and we needed to win today. So we weren’t going to give them an easy game,” said Bugaoan in Filipino. READ: Spikers’ Turf: Criss Cross gets […]...
